judged_text: Video booking references lose their credentialId: the non-calendar half of the ternary in EventManager.ts:169-170 changed from `result.credentialId` (the Zoom/Teams credential) to `undefined`, so every new booking's `_video` reference stores `credentialId: null`, breaking credential-based video-meeting deletion on cancel and `deleteCredentialHandler` matching, orphaning video meetings or picking the wrong credential when a user has multiple video integrations.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the reference object built in the `createdEvents.map(...)` block now sets `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly `externalCalendarId` only for calendar). This means for non-calendar integrations (e.g., video providers like Zoom/Teams where `isCalendarType` is false), the stored reference will no longer include `result.credentialId` and will end up `undefined`/null. The finding’s claim matches the diff: previously the non-calendar branch used `result.credentialId`, but now it’s explicitly `undefined`, which can break later credential-targeted operations (e.g., deletion or matching by credential).
